ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 65% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels in the central regions versus 35% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels along the perimeter and markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white central zone with dark peripheral banding (~5-10% lobe width). Dark vertical striations radiate from the trailing edge. A high-density dark pixel cluster is centered at the peduncle insertion point (base of the notch).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate vertex angle of 50 degrees; notch depth is approximately 12% of the total vertical pixel height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations along the entire trailing boundary. Notable macro-level indentation (missing tissue) on the distal posterior margin of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward convex sweep of the leading edges transitioning to a concave taper towards the distal tips on the trailing edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of localized reddish-brown pixel clusters on the mid-to-outer right ventral lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple sets of parallel, vertical, low-intensity linear streaks (rake marks) crossing the white pigmentation on both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Traumatic indentation/notch on the trailing edge of the right lobe near the distal tip; presence of multiple vertical rake marks across the fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Focal reddish-brown pigmentation/staining visible on the interior surface of the right fluke lobe.
